package: Burning Sun Celestial Scene — Spacing and Zoom Refinement
ui_scope: Celestial View opens by default with spherical Sun and Moon, dotted lunar orbit, and existing Earth/time controls preserved
changes: Open Celestial View on app startup with Sun selected.
Render Sun as a visually scaled ellipsoid with a locally generated plasma texture and soft corona halo.
Render Moon as a visually scaled ellipsoid with a locally generated crater texture.
Add a subtle dotted orbital path around Earth as a visual guide.
Preserve existing local Moon calculation, time scroller, camera interaction, and auto-exit logic.
limitations: Sun/Moon textures are procedural and not NASA imagery.
Celestial sizes and distances are visually scaled.
Moon calculation and dotted orbital path are approximate.
Requires iPhone/PWA runtime and performance testing.
title: EARTH // LIVE — Burning Sun Celestial Scene — Spacing and Zoom Refinement v1.38
description: Opens EARTH // LIVE directly into Celestial View with a visually scaled spherical burning Sun, textured lunar globe, and subtle dotted Moon-orbit guide. Retains the existing Earth assets, time scroller, centred dock, and responsive layout. Sun/Moon scale and orbit are illustrative; Moon calculation remains approximate. Requires iPhone/PWA testing.
